title: Netflix made one unpopular change — and gained millions of users

beats.narration: Netflix made one deeply unpopular change — and gained tens of millions of users.
For years, password sharing was everywhere, and Netflix mostly looked the other way.
Then in 2023, it started charging for accounts shared outside your own home.
Everyone expected people to quit. Instead, millions of freeloaders became paying subscribers.
Add a cheaper ad-supported plan, and Netflix now has over 300 million members.
The risky move that ended up printing money. Follow for more.
